blockers.required_input: The candidate treats 100 adjacent snapshots from a single run on a single host as independent samples for a confidence interval. What is the justification for assuming independence among these temporally adjacent observations? Actual autocorrelation/dependence structure must be measured or a justified sampling/dependence design provided before inferential intervals can be constructed.

The replication unit is one host and one run. What justification exists that a single-run, single-host measurement generalizes to the claimed fixed-configuration completion time of 12 ms, given that run-to-run and host-to-host variability are unexamined?

The source is described as a 'Synthetic text-only evaluation packet; no real paper was reviewed' with review_status 'partial-review'. What actual source data or paper grounds the claim that completion time is 12 ms under configuration A?
